name: Aurora Pulse
author: Charles Gameti
description: Radio, TV, YouTube, YouTube Music and local music in one bar widget: unified queue, picture-in-picture video with pinning, synced lyrics, EPG guide, 5-band EQ and crossfade.

barWidget.description: Radio, TV, YouTube, YouTube Music and local music with picture-in-picture video

schema.label: Show the title in the bar
schema.description: The bar shows the artist and title beside the icon. Turn it off for an icon-only widget.

schema.label: Title width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Longer titles scroll.

schema.label: Show which source is playing
schema.description: Radio, TV, YouTube, Music or Local, so the icon is never ambiguous when the title is off.

schema.label: Open the browser on
schema.description: Which source the panel shows when you open it.

schema.label: YouTube is audio only
schema.description: Streams the best audio track and never opens a video window. The fastest way to use YouTube as a music source.

schema.label: Crossfade
schema.description: Seconds of overlap between two audio items. Off by default; it only applies between audio, never across a video or a live stream.

schema.label: Resume where you left off
schema.description: Reopens timed media at the position you stopped at, once you are more than 30 seconds in.

schema.label: Remember volume per output
schema.description: Headphones and speakers keep their own volume, the way omarchy.audio does.

schema.label: Video quality
schema.description: Applies to YouTube and TV. The best is not always available, so this is a ceiling rather than a demand.

schema.label: Picture-in-picture corner
schema.description: Where a new video window opens. You can still drag and snap it anywhere.

schema.label: Hide video controls after
schema.description: Milliseconds of stillness before the overlay fades. Zero keeps it up.

schema.label: Hardware video decoding
schema.description: Falls back to software automatically when the hardware cannot handle a stream.

schema.label: Minimum station bitrate
schema.description: Kilobits per second. Hides the very low quality streams that radio directories are full of. Zero shows everything.

schema.label: Report plays to the station directory
schema.description: Tells Radio Browser you started a stream, which is how stations stay ranked. Turn it off to stop appearing in their statistics.

schema.label: Refresh the TV guide every
schema.description: Hours. The guide is a few megabytes, so this is a download you schedule rather than one you wait for.

schema.label: YouTube lookups per hour
schema.description: A ceiling on how many streams we resolve, so a stray loop cannot get you rate limited.

schema.label: Use YouTube's own lyrics
schema.description: On for YouTube Music tracks. Falls back to LRCLib and the lyrics sites when YouTube has none.

schema.label: Lyrics sources
schema.description: Tried in order. A .lrc file beside the track always wins over the network.

schema.label: Music folders
schema.description: Colon-separated folders to scan, for example ~/Music:~/Downloads/Music. Left empty, the XDG music directory is used.

schema.label: Offline mode
schema.description: Stop all network requests. Cached results, downloaded media and the local library still work.

schema.label: Anonymous usage
schema.description: Keeps anonymous counts so we can see which sources break. No account, no identifier, no per-person data.

schema.label: Start playing on launch
schema.description: Begin playing the last station as soon as the widget appears.

schema.label: Show stream bitrate in the browser
schema.description: Each row shows the codec and bitrate when the directory publishes them.

schema.label: Show the country in the browser
schema.description: Radio Browser knows where a station is from; showing it saves a guess.

schema.label: Download station artwork
schema.description: Fetched in the background after the list appears, so a slow image host never delays a station.

schema.label: Artwork downloads at once
schema.description: Higher fills the list faster. Six is polite to the hosts serving the images.

schema.label: Refresh the station list every
schema.description: Hours. The list is mirrored locally, so this only affects how fresh it is.

schema.label: Refresh the channel list every
schema.description: Hours. The channel list is mirrored locally as well.

schema.label: Stream buffer
schema.description: Seconds of media to buffer ahead. More is steadier on a poor connection and slower to seek.

schema.label: User-Agent for TV streams
schema.description: Some IPTV providers serve only known clients. A browser string is the usual thing that works.

schema.label: Hide geo-blocked channels
schema.description: Channels marked geo-blocked usually refuse to play for you.

schema.label: Hide channels that are not 24/7
schema.description: A channel that is not broadcasting shows a dead screen rather than an error.

schema.label: Hide adult channels
schema.description: iptv-org marks these, and they are not something to stumble into in a list.

schema.label: Start TV muted
schema.description: Live TV often has a much louder mix than a music stream.

schema.label: Follow symbolic links when scanning
schema.description: Off is safer: a link into a directory that changes can make a scan run for a very long time.
